title: Mechanic- Madang
description:
Islands Petroleum is an independently owned fuel and lubes distributor, and the exclusive distributor for Mobil lubricants in Papua New Guinea. With the head office based in Kokopo, Islands Petroleum also operates bulk fuel depots in Rabaul, Kimbe, Konebada, Kavieng, Alotau, Popondetta/ Orobay and Mt. Hagen as well as lubes and fuel distribution warehouses in Lae, Port Moresby, and Madang.
We are currently seeking to fill the position of
Mechanic
at our Madang Depot, Madang Province. Reporting to the Depot Manager, this position is critical for planning and carrying out Preventative Planned Maintenance (PPM) and reactive repairs of all company fleets ranging from Small Engines, Light Motor Vehicles, Forklifts, Trucks and Road Tankers.
Responsibilities:
Ensure all Light Vehicles, Road Tankers, Forklifts are always fully functional, by carrying out all routine checks, tests and service at the appropriate intervals, and taking necessary remedial action to rectify any issues detected
Ability to read and interpret parts and service manuals, facilitate requisitions and parts orders
Reporting of Sub-standards from Inspections to the workshop supervisors then gets repairs done on a timely manner
All Repair & Maintenance must be done according to schedules
Maintain a high level of health, safety and environmental culture and comply with Company policies and procedures
Provide Quality Service without compromising safety standards on a timely manner and provide feedback in an efficient manner
Responsible for the management of all company assets and ensuring that the assets are maintained at operational standards
Ensure Workshop is kept in a neat and tidy state
Key Requirements
A recognized Trade Certificate in Heavy Equipment Fitting or Automotive Mechanic
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in working on Small Engines, Light Vehicles, Trucks, Road Tankers
Proven experience in component overhauling
Provide consistent reporting – daily, weekly, and monthly basis
Ability to handle multiple tasks and see tasks through to completion
Enthusiasm to train and mentor Tradesmen, Trade Assistants, and unskilled employees
Good command of oral and written communications skills
Hold a current PNG Driver’s license preferably Class 6
Ability to manage multiple tasks with well-developed time management skills, an ability toprioritize the work.
Excellent communication skills
Team Player and neat and tidy appearance
Madang based candidates will be given first preference
To Apply
